title: Design Revised for Carttera's 19-Storey Dupont-Ossington Rentals
summary: Angled balcony bands distinguish the new design for 888 Dupont Street, where shoring for excavation began in July, 2026. Designed by Graziani + Corazza Architects for Carttera Private Equities, the rental development retains its 19 storeys at the north end of Toronto’s Christie Pits neighbourhood. The September, 2026 Site Plan Approval resubmission responds to City comments with revised massing and facades.
